Exposure readings differed by at most2C, while the table footnote gives0.2C from NaCl. Neither supplies raw NaCl cell values or covariance of the temperature-calibration coefficients needed to reconstruct uncertainty in an independent reduction.
The lattice and volume columns are both reported, so a^3/3a^2sigma_a is a source-column precision/error-propagation control, not new measured observations.
Source-consistent control retains listed NaCl temperatures. Inversion to thermocouple temperatures and a second application of Eq1 are unsupported stage-error hypotheses.
